client.responsibility: UI rendering, user interaction, local state management

server.responsibility: Data persistence, authentication, authorization, API endpoints

data_flow: React Query triggers Supabase client call
Supabase validates auth token and RLS policies
Response flows back through React Query cache

assumptions: Users have modern browsers supporting ES2020+
Supabase free tier is sufficient for initial load
Single-page application is acceptable for this use case

spec.decision: Use Supabase as BaaS to eliminate backend boilerplate
constraints: Must use Row Level Security for data isolation
Frontend must be deployable to Vercel
spec.rationale: Minimizes development time while maintaining production-ready security and scalability

meta.notes: Architecture handoff from Planner to Coordinator. Ready for task breakdown.
